provenance.evidenceType: Selected numerical facts transcribed from published reverse-engineering findings; acceleration fixture author reports original TIMWIN memory inspection

units.gravity: original environment setting; not metres per second squared
units.airPressure: original environment setting; not pascals or our Pressure multiplier
units.density: original internal parameter; SI conversion unknown
units.acceleration: original signed internal increment; positive downward in referenced implementation
units.terminalVelocity: original internal component limit; time/length conversion unverified
units.mass: original internal parameter; relative ratios may be compared without an absolute scale
units.bounciness: original internal material parameter; not directly a rebound-height ratio
units.friction: original internal material parameter; not our multiplicative contact factor

limitations: These are upstream-reported memory fixtures and parameters, not trajectories measured in this workspace.
Do not assume TIM2/3, original DOS TIM, and Windows TEMIM use identical values or update rules.
Sprite dimensions are not proof of exact collision bounds.
OpenTIM is explicitly in progress and may contain reconstruction errors or VANILLAFIX changes.
Do not use these findings to silently change campaign physics or assistance.
Original executable timing, collision response, fixed-point scaling, and native/browser compatibility still require independent validation.
